claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this ROCK/PKA-directed compound most plausibly kills cells through a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress mechanism rather than selective kinase inhibition, producing a broad but non-specific pattern of killing.
